Put your creativity

What it's like at Simply

Marketing cookies must be accepted to watch this video.

Building products that people love with cutting-edge technology

Our learners are at the heart of everything we do. We combine real human insight - from testing, data, and constant conversation with our community - with deep product expertise and advanced AI. Our patented acoustic note recognition engine, 2D and 3D rendering, and deep learning work together so our apps can listen, watch, and respond in real time, giving every learner personalized feedback and guidance.

The result is an experience that feels intuitive, adapts to each one of us, and makes learning a new creative hobby simple and fun.

Building together to create real impact

Impact Velocity

Focus on what truly matters to get things done and drive meaningful progress.

Co-building

Empowered teams that work independently while fostering strong, collaborative partnerships.

Focused & independent teams

We work in small teams, called pods. Each pod is focused on a single mission or objective, whether it’s business, product, or culture - with all the necessary talent and full ownership of their mission.

Ownership & accountability

Research, data, and well-thought-out professional logic back up every decision we make. We own both the wins and failures - so we're always learning.

Tools, not rules

Pods have all the resources they need, without the bureaucracy. To do so well we speak openly, share constructive feedback, and build trust that allows us to challenge each other to be our best.
